capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Quick web lookup (rough, not cross-checked). Gross capacity.

chemistry.notes: Both EV9 packs NMC (SK On) per EV Seekers; EV Database lists NMC for the 99.8 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Manual switch plus conditioning timed to a fast charger set as waypoint/destination (MV1 2026 manual; MV1 is the EV9 per the en_US specs page). Cited page is the UK copy; the en_US copy of this page was not found. Manual says the feature applies only to vehicles with a battery heater.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database GT listing: 96.0 kWh usable of 99.8 kWh nominal.

ac_max_kw.notes: EV Database (European listing): 11 kW AC; US sheets give 10.9 kW for other EV9 trims. No GT-specific US/Canadian page found.

dc_max_kw.notes: EV Database lists 206 kW for the GT, matching an Australian Kia spec sheet (via Zecar). Other 99.8 kWh trims: 210 kW.
